deliberatelyDeferred.reason: Playbill has no confirmed venue yet ("theatre + opening not yet confirmed"); only an approximate first-preview month ("February 2027"). Matches the codebase's existing defer-don't-stub convention (discover-new-shows.js cards #994/#1060). fetchShowsFromPlaybillBroadway() will pick this up automatically once Playbill publishes a venue.

gap1RootCause.claim: Comment in tony-awards/predictions/[season]/page.tsx blamed IBDB returning a bot challenge for the 6 shows with null openingDate.
evidence: That specific bug (ibdb.com in PLAYWRIGHT_FIRST_DOMAINS, Cloudflare challenge accepted as success) was real but was already fixed in commit 136cc7f9bd8 on 2026-08-05 (scripts/lib/scraper.js:82-87) — 'BD web_unlocker2 fetches IBDB fine — let it go straight there.'

The Aug 12 scheduled run (gh run 31577283452) shows enrich-ibdb-dates.js successfully fetching IBDB pages via Scrapingdog and extracting correct openingDate for galileo-2026 (2026-12-06), inter-alia-2026 (2026-12-01), and paranormal-activity-2026 (2026-08-25) — no bot challenge involved.

The actual blocker: applying those 3 shows' openingDate made their PRE-EXISTING awards.json tony.season placeholders (all '1969-70', 0 nominations/wins — fabricated) inconsistent (validate-data.js's Tony-season-vs-openingDate check, added recently). validate-data.js correctly flagged this as 3 NEW errors. evaluateCommitDecision (scripts/lib/validation-setdiff.js) is an ALL-OR-NOTHING gate: 3 new errors blocked the commit for the entire batch of 11 shows, discarding 8 shows' completely clean writes (Dolly, School Girls, Evita, The Fantasticks, Gloria, Billy Crystal 860, Paddington, Purple Rain) along with the 3 broken ones. The push-refusal sentinel then blocked that week's push-core-data step entirely.

awake-and-sing-2026 and the-imaginary-invalid-2026 hit a DIFFERENT, correctly-firing guard: their stored ibdbUrl points at a decades-old prior Broadway production of the same title (1935 / 1967), and ibdb-year-guard.js correctly refused to trust that data as wrong-production contamination — this is not a bug, IBDB genuinely can't answer for these two without a URL correction.
billy-crystal-860-2026's openingDate was found cleanly by IBDB in the same Aug 12 run but was discarded anyway by the same all-or-nothing gate.

gap1Fix.description: scripts/lib/validation-setdiff.js: new evaluatePerShowCommitDecision() attributes each new validation error to the show ID it names (validate-data.js quotes the ID in every per-show error) and only holds back those specific shows, committing the rest. If any new error can't be attributed to a candidate show, falls back to the original block-everything behavior. scripts/enrich-ibdb-dates.js now snapshots each touched show before mutating it, and on a partial block, reverts just the implicated show(s) and re-validates to CONFIRM the revert actually cleared the error before trusting the attribution.
gap1Fix.test: tests/unit/discovery-validation-setdiff.test.mjs (attributeNewErrorsToShowIds, evaluatePerShowCommitDecision — reproduces the exact card #1426 scenario: 3 of 11 shows blocked, 8 commit)
gap1Fix.collateralFix: Deleted the wanted-2022 awards.json placeholder (tony.season=1975-76) that would have hit the exact same class of error the moment this session set its real openingDate.
